Material that decides the line is

* 4th displayed rank d4 O e4 O
* up-right diagonal c6 O d5 O e4 O

The fourth square of the diagonal is f3 and f3 only becomes playable once column f is filled to row 4.

* O f4. Row4 becomes d4 O e4 O f4 O. Immediate winning continuations on the next O ply are
c4 → c4 d4 e4 f4,
g4 → d4 e4 f4 g4,
f3 → c6 d5 e4 f3.
X can block at most one of them so O wins on the next O move. This is the textbook double-ended horizontal open three with diagonal pressure.

* O c4. Row4 becomes c4 O d4 O e4 O. The unique immediate horizontal finisher is f4. If X does not play f4 O wins at once c4 d4 e4 f4. X f4 is therefore forced, column f is now filled to row 4 and f3 is now playable, so O wins next on the diagonal c6 O d5 O e4 O f3 O. No other legal first drop forces a win in two O plies; a4, b5, d3, e3 give no forced 2-ply win.
